headline: Missouri S&T take the opening conference points
dek: Missouri S&T beat Upper Iowa in the conference's opening match, their third win from three, with eight goals scored and one conceded. Six different players have scored for them.
displaced_by: Conference play opened and Missouri S&T won the first conference match

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southwest Baptist's fifteen goals from two matches exceed the combined total of Lewis, Lincoln, Maryville, Illinois Springfield, Indianapolis, Missouri-St. Louis, Upper Iowa and William Jewell; the shape is one side and a field.

wire.line: Southwest Baptist have won both matches without conceding and open conference play at home to Missouri-St. Louis.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches past their date carry no published result: Drury's at home to Evangel and away at Wash U, and Missouri S&T's visit to Kentucky Wesleyan. No final is missing its score.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Upper Iowa have drawn twice and lost once, scoring one goal in all and conceding two; Noah Nymark-Pedersen has made twelve saves behind them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Rockhurst have conceded ten goals, more than any other programme, and their two defeats have come at Fort Hays State and at home to Rogers State.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Seven different players have scored Southwest Baptist's fifteen goals; Nathaniel Velasquez has three of them, with an assist, from ten shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: William Jewell have yet to score, losing both their matches and conceding four, and host Lewis in their conference opener.

last_match.line: Upper Iowa arrived unbeaten after draws at Roosevelt and at Viterbo; Missouri S&T's visit to Kentucky Wesleyan still has no published result.

next_match.line: Drury have won away at Northeastern State since losing at home to Oklahoma Christian; Truman have scored in every match and conceded in every one too.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
